title: Trump Cancels Planned Execution Livestream of Nidal Hasan, Fort Hood Shooter
summary: The president said only immediate families of the victims of the mass shooting in 2009 would witness the execution of Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan.
body_markdown: The president said only immediate families of the victims of the mass shooting in 2009 would witness the execution of Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan.
